topic: South Africa filter requirements and timeline
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on South Africa's request for time granulation filters. Initially, [p1] relayed a request from the client asking for existing time granularity filters to be available in all environments, and additionally requested filters by weekday (Mon-Fri) and by weekend (Sat-Sun).

Regarding implementation timelines, it was determined that the next release is anticipated on Tuesday. It was agreed that this timeline would be communicated to the South African client.
decisions: The South African client's request for weekday/weekend filters will be addressed in the next scheduled release (Tuesday).
action_items: Follow up on estimates and prioritization of the task.
